_help: Weapon types. Poses are in the hero's model space (forward -Z, right +X, metres): h = hand position, d = [yaw, pitch] of the weapon in degrees (yaw +90 = points left, pitch +90 = points up). Each attack: dur (s at speed 1), wind (fraction spent winding up), hit (fraction when damage lands), dmg (x weapon damage), arc (half-angle, degrees), range (m), knock, stun (s), up (knock-up speed), lunge (m), spin (degrees the body turns), finisher (true = combo finisher, boosted by finisher passives), keys = [wind-up pose, mid-swing pose, follow-through pose]. Scaling: base 5 + str/dex/mag x attribute + item damage, times dmg. onHit = status chances per hit.

kitModels._help: Twin Realms kit weapon models (assets/models/kit/weapons/<name>.glb) each weapon type can show. An item with a Model field shows that model; otherwise one is picked from its type's list by the item's name, so a weapon keeps its look. use = false: the built-in meshes everywhere. Not listed (no matching type yet): shield_round, shield_kite, shield_tower, buckler, crossbow, chakram, claws.
